headline: Doom - the shooter that changed PC gaming
title: Doom 1993 | Release Facts | Classic Games
video_script: Doom is a PC legend. Developed by id Software for MS-DOS, the first shareware version of Doom was released on December tenth, nineteen ninety three. You play a space marine fighting demons on the moons of Mars and in hell. Its fast first person action became a landmark in gaming history. Did you ever play Doom on an old PC? Comment below!
description: Doom, developed by id Software for MS-DOS, had its first shareware release on December 10, 1993, sending players through Mars and hell as a space marine.
